description: This file defines a React component 'RequireAuth' that enforces authentication requirements for rendering its children. It redirects unauthenticated users to the '/auth' route when Supabase authentication is enabled. It relies on React, react-router-dom, and a custom AuthContext.

methods.name: RequireAuth({ children })
methods.description: A React functional component that checks authentication status via useAuth hook. It displays a loading state, redirects unauthenticated users when needed, or renders its children if authenticated.
